# infisical_identity_kubernetes_auth_template (Data Source)

Look up a Kubernetes auth template by ID or name, for use with the `template_id` attribute on `infisical_identity_kubernetes_auth`. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set. The token reviewer JWT is write-only and never returned. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported for this data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

data "infisical_identity_kubernetes_auth_template" "by-name" {
  name = "<template-name>"
}

data "infisical_identity_kubernetes_auth_template" "by-id" {
  id = "<template-id>"
}

resource "infisical_identity_kubernetes_auth" "kubernetes-auth-demo" {
  identity_id        = "<identity-id>"
  template_id        = data.infisical_identity_kubernetes_auth_template.by-name.id
  allowed_namespaces = ["infisical-ns"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The ID of the auth template.
- `name` (String) The name of the auth template. Names are not unique, so a lookup by a name that several Kubernetes templates share fails and must use `id` instead.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_audience` (String) The audience claim that service account JWTs must carry to authenticate.
- `gateway_id` (String) The ID of the gateway Kubernetes API requests are routed through.
- `gateway_pool_id` (String) The ID of the gateway pool Kubernetes API requests are routed through.
- `has_token_reviewer_jwt` (Boolean) Whether Infisical holds a token reviewer JWT for this template.
- `kubernetes_ca_certificate` (String) The PEM-encoded CA certificate used to validate the Kubernetes API server's TLS certificate.
- `kubernetes_host` (String) The host string, host:port pair, or URL to the base of the Kubernetes API server.
- `token_reviewer_mode` (String) Who performs the TokenReview: `api` or `gateway`.
- `verify_tls_certificate` (Boolean) Whether the Kubernetes API server's TLS certificate is verified.
